findings.evidence: `Graphon.ofMatrix_apply` RHS is `(b i j : ℝ)` (Graphon/OfMatrix.lean:75-76); `Set.Icc.coe_zero`/`coe_one` are `@[simp, norm_cast]` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Interval/Set/Instances.lean:68,72 and are used explicitly elsewhere in the repo (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/TotallyReal/Maslov/Index.lean:239).
findings.fix: Use the explicit lemmas: `split <;> simp` or `rw [adjacency, Graphon.ofMatrix_apply]; split <;> [exact Set.Icc.coe_zero; exact Set.Icc.coe_one]`.
findings.issue: `split <;> rfl` closes `↑(0 : Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) = 0` and `↑(1 : Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) = 1` by unfolding the `Zero`/`One` instances on the subtype — undocumented reliance on definitional equality across a coercion.

findings.evidence: Lines 97-107; `Finpartition.parts_bipartition` (TauCeti/Order/Partition/Finpartition.lean:32) already states the parts as an explicit `Finset`, so the image can be evaluated rather than reasoned about pointwise.
findings.fix: Compute the part set directly instead of via membership: `rw [fine, Finpartition.parts_inf, coarse_parts, Finpartition.parts_bipartition]` then a full `simp [h0, h1, h2, h02, hn]`, leaving only the four intersection facts in the simp set. Same for the `Nat.reducePow` simproc copied into `simpa only [hceil, Nat.reducePow]` at line 242 — use `simpa [hceil] using hcard`.
findings.issue: `fine_parts` is a 22-line proof whose `simp only` list mixes mathematical facts with simp-output artifacts (`Fin.isValue`, `or_self`, `not_false_eq_true`, `empty_ne_singleton`, `Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem`, `Prod.exists`) and then hand-rolls both membership directions; any change to `Finpartition.parts_inf`'s normal form breaks the whole block.

findings.fix: Make the normalizer terminal: at line 74 use `simp only [...]` followed by `push_cast; ring` (or `field_simp; ring`); at lines 114-115 use `by fin_cases i <;> simp [p]` and `by fin_cases j <;> simp [q]`.
findings.issue: Non-terminal normalizing tactics whose successor depends on the exact residual goal: `norm_num` then `ring` (lines 74-75), and `simp [p]; split <;> simp_all` / `simp [q]; split <;> simp_all` (lines 114-115) where `split` only applies if `simp` happens not to resolve the `ite`.

findings.evidence: `Set.Nonempty.ne_empty` is an alias of `nonempty_iff_ne_empty` at mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Set/Basic.lean:480.
findings.fix: One-liner in both places: `have h : ({2}ᶜ : Set (Fin 3)) ≠ ∅ := Set.Nonempty.ne_empty ⟨0, by simp⟩` and `Set.Nonempty.ne_empty ⟨1, by simp⟩`.
findings.issue: The same three-line nonemptiness idiom (`intro h; have : _ ∈ _ := by simp; simp [h] at this`) is repeated verbatim at lines 80-83 and 92-95.

findings.evidence: The `.real` family is declared `@[simp]` in mathlib/Mathlib/Probability/Distributions/Bernoulli.lean:96-142; `measureReal_prod_prod` already produces `weights.real p * weights.real q`, so the ENNReal round trip is avoidable.
findings.fix: Drop `measureReal_def`/`bernoulliMeasure_apply` in favour of the `.real` simp lemmas that match the goal `measureReal_prod_prod` leaves (`bernoulliMeasure_real_apply`, `bernoulliMeasure_real_apply_of_mem_of_notMem`, `..._of_notMem_of_notMem`), and `Set.indicator_of_mem`/`Set.indicator_of_notMem` instead of unfolding `Set.indicator`; factor the shared `stepGraphonAvg_apply … setAverage_eq, measureReal_prod_prod, ← integral_indicator, integral_weights_prod` chain into one private helper.
findings.issue: `coarseAvg_apply` and `fineAvg_apply` close through `norm_num [p, q, measureReal_def, weights, bernoulliMeasure_apply, adjacency_apply, Set.indicator]` (lines 119-121, 132-134): they unfold `measureReal_def` back into `ENNReal.toReal` and feed norm_num a hypothesis-and-instance-carrying lemma, plus unfold `Set.indicator`. The preceding 5-step rewrite chain is also duplicated verbatim between the two lemmas.

summary: Proofs are mostly concrete computation, but one step closes a subtype-coercion goal by bare `rfl`, `fine_parts` rests on a 14-name `simp only` list full of simp-output artifacts, and several normalizing tactics are non-terminal with the next tactic depending on their exact residual shape.
